method: Compiled all four Python fences, executed only the fixed workflow example and the constructed paired-metrics fixture, and stubbed the legacy response parser with an empty end_turn payload to verify fail-closed behavior. No provider calls were made.
limitations: The paired task outcomes and latency values are constructed examples; they do not estimate model quality, architecture benefit, scheduling behavior, uncertainty or sample size.

The legacy DeepSeek-compatible script was not run. Its old aggregate output cannot be independently reproduced because per-call requests, responses, exact model identity, scoring records and billing data are unavailable.

The legacy script runs workers sequentially, so it does not measure parallel latency. The revised sample code does not score answer quality or compliance. The empty end_turn check is a local contract test, not evidence that every provider returns this shape.
The 14.4x API/UI comparison has different execution boundaries and success criteria; it does not establish a deterministic-tool versus agent-subtask cost ratio.
No provider, current endpoint, production workflow, real tool, latency path or bill was tested.
